title: Graceful Shutdown & Health‑Check Endpoint
description: Adds a robust graceful shutdown process that closes server connections, flushes logs, and stops accepting new requests, plus a `/healthz` endpoint for Kubernetes/liveness checks. This improves reliability and observability in production environments.
testCases: Server responds with 200 and JSON {status:"ok"} on GET /healthz
Server stops accepting new connections after SIGTERM and existing connections finish before process exit
acceptance:
- `/healthz` returns HTTP 200 with `{ "status": "ok" }` within 50 ms.
- On SIGTERM, the server stops listening, waits for all active requests to complete (max 10 s), then exits with code 0.
- Logs appropriate shutdown messages.
- No unhandled promise rejections or open handles after shutdown.
reason: Ensures the framework can be safely deployed in container orchestration platforms and reduces downtime during deployments or crashes, addressing a critical production‑readiness gap.
